invariants.rationale: The method getPartitioner calls getUpsertPartitioner or getInsertPartitioner with profile, indicating profile should be non-null.
Typical workload profile usage assumes that workload stats are available for partitioning.
The number of records to insert in the workload stats should not be negative.
The number of records to update should also not be negative.
Partitioner logic typically expects at least one partition in profile's stats.
